author: Clijmart
body:
Hey Avicus Players!

I decided to make another map, also this one is DTM.
This one is called SquaredNature and has 2 monuments, also, when you kill somebody you get string and golden apples :)

Link to pictures: http://imgur.com/a/7oMHN
Link to YAML: http://pastebin.com/0Xyi2SHY (Thanks Jiveh!) (Sorry Jiveh, forgot it at first xD)
Link to Map Download: https://www.mediafire.com/folder/89l92dqdoq3mp/SquaredNature_%5BDTM%5D

Please leave me some feedback if possible...
(Thanks MilkyWayRules for helping)

Bai,
Clijmart

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Congratulations!

Your Map, Squared Nature, has been accepted for testing!



Here are some Map Developer Comments:


"HOT" - timaeusTestified


"Another Palm rust like Map. Could work like Palm Rust but might be better with more elevation" - Edans


"I like that a lot, though would be much better as ctw imo" - Xuph



Please add me on Skype (Sethskye) if you have Skype so we can go on further details on Testing or on how to improve this map more or you can find me on The Avicus TeamSpeak.
